summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K on 19 August 2026 announcing the completion of its £500 million share buyback programme launched on 12 March 2026. The company purchased 1,569,800 ordinary shares for cancellation on 17–18 August 2026 at volume-weighted average prices of approximately 352.0p to 352.75p per share. The programme concluded with 144,012,239 shares repurchased and cancelled since the start of the year. Post-settlement, registered share capital was 8,808,341,409 shares with 11,807,443 held in treasury, leaving 8,796,533,966 voting shares. This open-market buyback is a routine capital return, with no premium or structural complexity; watch for future programme announcements.
